title: Each session is held under the POC before it, then closes through its low
premise: Asia and London build their brackets and volume profiles on the chart. Watch London rally back to the Asia POC and close below it, then close through the Asia low; New York does the same with the London POC and the London low.

chapters.title: ASIA CLOSED
chapters.text: Asia closes: ASIA HIGH 26,128.00 and ASIA LOW 25,986.00 are final, with the POC at 26,074.00, the busiest 1-point level of its profile. The levels carry forward dotted until Asia opens again.

chapters.title: AT THE ASIA POC
chapters.text: London trades back to the ASIA POC 26,074.00 for the first time since Asia closed, and the bar closes back below it at 26,065.00. Its carried line fades from here.

chapters.title: ASIA LOW TAKEN
chapters.text: A close at 25,971.25, below the ASIA LOW 25,986.00. From this bar the rest of its dotted line fades; it stays on the chart until Asia opens again.

chapters.title: LONDON CLOSED
chapters.text: London closes: LONDON HIGH 26,074.25 and LONDON LOW 25,896.00 are final, with the POC at 25,929.75. The levels carry forward dotted until London opens again.

chapters.title: AT THE LONDON POC
chapters.text: New York trades back to the LONDON POC 25,929.75 for the first time since London closed, and the bar closes back below it at 25,924.25. Its carried line fades from here.

chapters.title: LONDON LOW TAKEN
chapters.text: A close at 25,880.25, below the LONDON LOW 25,896.00. From this bar the rest of its dotted line fades; it stays on the chart until London opens again.
